WITH target_days AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002 AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN target_days td ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
),
web_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN target_days td ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
),
catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN target_days td ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = td.d_date_sk
),
state_addresses AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        cd.cd_gender,
        cd.cd_marital_status,
        cd.cd_education_status,
        cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
        cd.cd_credit_rating,
        count(*) AS cnt
    FROM state_addresses sa
    JOIN customer c ON c.c_current_addr_sk = sa.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN store_customers sc ON c.c_customer_sk = sc.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN web_customers wc ON c.c_customer_sk = wc.ws_bill_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN catalog_customers cc ON c.c_customer_sk = cc.cs_ship_customer_sk
    WHERE wc.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
      AND cc.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL
    GROUP BY cd.cd_gender, cd.cd_marital_status, cd.cd_education_status,
             cd.cd_purchase_estimate, cd.cd_credit_rating
)
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    cnt AS cnt1,
    cd_purchase_estimate,
    cnt AS cnt2,
    cd_credit_rating,
    cnt AS cnt3
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status,
         cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
